set.gloss: number eight (shirt or midfield role in football); the figure eight; an eight (card)

why: 'quarter-finals' is οκτάδα, not οκτάρι; removed wrong sense
stress variant of known lemma στερεός (same word, same senses)
perfect participle of συμβάλλομαι/συμβάλλω, which is in known lemmas

example.el: Ένας τράκτορας ανετράπη στην Εθνική Οδό και προκάλεσε μποτιλιάρισμα.
example.en: A tractor unit overturned on the national highway and caused a traffic jam.

why: farmers block roads with τρακτέρ (farm tractors), not τράκτορες; example misused the headword
gen.pl εκτρόπων shifts stress (θέατρο type), so n-ο-a not n-ο-b
